notes.title: Meet Kiran, Lysward’s Protagonist.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Explorers! 
[/h1][p]Today’s update is very special: Meet Kiran, the character you’ll play as in Lysward. After escaping the Notus facility with no memories and a strange device fused to his forearm, Kiran awakens in a desolate cave, forced to survive a desert that wants him dead. His name is pronounced “Kee-ren”.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/7e324480ace108934cfb72312142a44df9344960.jpg"][/img]
[i]Kiran’s concept art.
[/i][/p][p]Kiran’s visual journey from concept to final character was a long one. His first iteration was created as a style test for our art and animation teams, a placeholder that allowed them to explore movement and tone. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/901a4d684793b04c495b9d57471d9a7c37dd3673.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Old concept.
[/i][/p][p]Creating Kiran demanded more than just concept art: It required weaving his entire story into his visual identity. Our art team worked closely with our skilled narrative designer, [url="https://hannahwerner.jimdofree.com/"][u]Hannah[/u][/url], and the talented artist [url="https://www.artstation.com/jeleynai"][u]Jeleynai[/u][/url], using every story beat and gameplay need as the foundation for their concept art. This incredible collaboration began with broad exploratory sketches, each iteration bringing us closer to a character who feels authentically shaped by his harsh world.
[/p][p]Every detail from the functionality of his Amri sleeve to the wear and tear on his clothing had to reflect his harrowing escape and fight for survival.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/7eebaafd7857052a51efb29fc127615dcf8a60c6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/014d046c0357440579d3c6119430c84d071772d2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/146baa9f3ccb181e69d2e7fa4dc7ef44ab244c8b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/3a24f7244c5931f9b40fb45030ed28c3dcf37260.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Kiran sketches.[/i][/p][p]
But a protagonist’s design isn’t just about aesthetics: It’s about making players connect with their struggle. Through dozens of iterations, we refined Kiran into someone players immediately understand yet still want to uncover.[/p][p]
We had to hit a lot of notes, from the Amri-sleeve on his arm hinting at the function we had from the writing, through his outfit needing to fit where Kiran enters the story in the game, to how his face looks to convey who he is as a person. When you first see Kiran, you should feel his history before he speaks a word. That’s the power of thoughtful character design.[/p][p]
We’re thrilled with the result and can’t wait for you to step into his shoes. What do you think of Kiran? [/p][p]
[b]We’ll have a closed playtest coming soon, so stay tuned and wishlist Lysward.[/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/6acdebeb7a275da3af8edc53458ebb77f26ae549.png"][/img]See you in the next update, Explorers!
[i][b]Snowcastle Games[/b][/i][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Character Reveal: Gjorna, The Trusty Ally.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Explorers!  [/h1][p]Today, we have a very special reveal. Meet Gjorna, your mentor and ally in the unforgiving world of Lysward. And in case you’re wondering, the pronunciation of her name is “[i]Yor-na[/i]”.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd7r0fG4egipdpC_gDYcpxJiPhuYtTLQbqhVI9ra_L2J077nggfhQi4IjvIVUUHnZ8QxeDmlbZmBPjs4H3Gt1UYJidPj5uywKjjgvwF_KWiGTk7qS99-z9RHCB_zdtBHtgOac1A3Q?key=JjI06fAmUJWwuFJqDO8m4w"][/img][i]Character Concept Art.
[/i][/p][p]Gjorna is no ordinary guide. She's a resourceful Hogbunny fugitive, desperately searching for her missing partner Orren after escaping the cruel experiments of Notus Haven. When your paths cross in the desert, you'll work together to uncover the terrible truth behind Notus' exploitation of the land... and what they did to both of you.[/p][p]
Now, if you’ve played Hogworld, EARTHLOCK, Ikonei Island, or read our comics, you might have noticed that Gjorna is a Hogbunny, but her visuals are very different from the others. This happened because we felt Lysward demanded a fresh take on Hogbunnies so they could fit in this environment.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdX3gumgvbSFfLnnCpvm4Owosh9_JhxiSdfEPmMOECA1qfOicrzHvl8TTICboib_8FZZqiluwM71V8vIl4f3ZScEIjzewC6FniFX-4T1l8TMlyQ6K3Ds32UA1WrjcJVkMDCBK5N?key=JjI06fAmUJWwuFJqDO8m4w"][/img][i]Hedda and Gnart variations.
[/i][/p][p]To achieve her final visual, we’ve tested and experimented a lot. We needed more expressive animations, which led to proportion changes, while the art style evolved to match the game's mature themes. After countless iterations, we arrived at her final design: a perfect balance of grit and personality that fits Lysward's harsh environment.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/05e27b09204b9f88248a9a93e1632d9dede77bb3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/7319730403bc33caed57f89a4cd4f41275174970.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/60605025812470644838c8276f94eeabd2697ca9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/7c545d2713ae3e37c04903e953f8bab3835a6a6b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/5fb0d9f47b93b6dc55157d4c1cadfa7cd81e9509.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/47de94e56e659d9c852619cae093ac4dea880e62.png"][/img][/carousel][p][i]Gjorna Sketches and experimentation.[/i]

Gjorna will be your most valuable company in the desert. Every clue she shares reveals more about your shared, painful past and the dark secrets of Notus Haven.

What are your thoughts on Gjorna? Let us know in the comments. [/p][p]
Wishlist Lysward to help us grow our community![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/6acdebeb7a275da3af8edc53458ebb77f26ae549.png"][/img]We’ll see you in the next update, Explorers! [/p][p][b][i]Snowcastle Games[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Inside Our Art Process: Building Lysward’s "Beauty Corner"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Explorers!  [/h1]

Today, we’re pulling back the curtain on an early but crucial part of our art process: the "Beauty Corner."
[h3]What’s a Beauty Corner?[/h3]
It’s a small, controlled scene where we test Lysward’s visual DNA—think desert rocks, hardy plants, and man-made debris—alongside early character designs. This lets us judge style cohesion before we’re neck-deep in production.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/295e5ed78b37f53c32822439348cdee2f51d2e57.png[/img] [i]Beauty corner work in progress.[/i]

[h3]What We’ve Learned (So Far):[/h3]
"Painterly Realism" in action: We’ve refined how sculpted edges and textures interact, with bold brushstrokes and hue shifts that pop against the geometry.

Lighting Reset: Our first lighting setup clashed with the assets, so we’ve stripped it back to neutral for now. Next step: tweak it once all pieces are in place.

Pipeline Checks: This corner has already exposed workflow kinks we’re smoothing out (goodbye, future headaches!).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/2338dd454c16d652f3a1cc927e8a20668fd7175c.png[/img] [i]Beauty corner work in progress.[/i]


Every rock and rusted girder here will inform how the entire world of Lysward looks and feels. And yes, this is all still WIP—we’ll share polished shots later!

Bonus: We’re also running art style tests for characters—here’s the latest update. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/b76a942b2d30271c48e99f8b9b8a5b2b6e2f39be.png[/img]

Add Lysward to your wishlist! It shows us how much interest there is in the game and helps with visibility.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/6acdebeb7a275da3af8edc53458ebb77f26ae549.png[/img]

We’ll see you in the next update, Explorers!
[b][i]Snowcastle Games[/i][/b]

notes.title: Reshaping The Speeder: Our Beetle-Inspired Design
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Explorers![/h1]

Today, let's talk about the Speeder - your trusty desert ride in Lysward! This compact but speedy vehicle isn't just for crossing the dunes; it's also a mobile base for you and your companion.

Our first Speeder design (from the teaser) didn't quite fit - it felt disconnected from EARTHLOCK's world and Lysward's unique desert style. We knew we needed to take a step back, so our art team came up with some cool ideas we want to share with you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/ad74d1bbbe8d979b5684d58faae55c0648f583cd.png[/img]
[i]Old Speeder concept art.[/i][hr][/hr]
To achieve visuals that match our world and lore, the art team explored options that combined the Speeder's functionality with desert elements from the game. They created four variations: one resembling a beetle, another looking like a boat, a third inspired by a plane, and some mashups of those three.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/c1782974dc66f4ff444714feaabd4eb6cf33b728.jpg[/img]
[i]Speeder Variations[/i][hr][/hr]
Our team fell in love with the beetle-inspired look, drawing inspiration from scarabs that thrive in harsh desert environments. Plus, it now fits the world visually.

The original beetle variation had weight balance issues and limited mobility on sand dunes, so we added a new suspension. This lets the skids pivot and absorb shocks, which is crucial for uneven terrain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/96aee08f35bf1e9cb10bf7952dda0e3f76206011.png[/img]
[i]New suspension[/i][hr][/hr]
[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
Right now, we're working on additional concept art for the cockpit design. Once that's locked in, we'll begin the long process of 3D modeling, rigging, animating, and implementing the Speeder to ensure it works perfectly in-game. You can follow updates here on our page, so don't forget to wishlist!

We will be having a closed playtest soon, so don’t forget to join our Discord community if you want to be part of it!

notes.title: Discover The Amri Sleeve, Your Key To Survival
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Explorers![/h1]

Let’s dive into one of the most essential tools in Lysward: the Amri Sleeve. Powered by the ancient Amri magic, this device is your lifeline in the unforgiving desert.

With the Amri Sleeve, you’ll unlock Glyphs—mystical symbols that channel Amri magic to create different effects in the world. As you explore, you’ll discover and learn new Glyphs, craft them, and equip them to your sleeve, unlocking abilities crucial for survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/f12e76c58a32a84c5201dbddefc5501843c8d8e4.png[/img]
[i]Amri Sleeve early prototype[/i]

So far, we’ve implemented three Glyphs: Cutting, Identify, and Repair. This is just the first version of the Amri Sleeve, and we’re still hard at work refining it—but we couldn’t wait to share what we have for now,

The Cutting Glyph allows players to harvest resources more efficiently, enabling them to gather materials from the environment that can only be harvested with this tool.

The Identify Glyph provides crucial information about objects and their properties, opening up new recipes and crafting options.

The Repair Glyph is needed for repairing the Speeder for now, but it’ll also be useful for other things in the future.

[previewyoutube=X0r4hIPIIyY;full][/previewyoutube]

And that’s just the beginning! We’re working on implementing more Glyphs to expand the Amri Sleeve’s capabilities, giving you even more ways to interact with the world. Any ideas on what the next Glyph will look like? Leave a comment below!

Stay tuned as we continue to develop and refine this powerful tool. The desert is full of secrets, and the Amri Sleeve will help you uncover them all.

Hit that wishlist button to help us understand your interest in our game, and join our Discord community if you want to be part of the future closed betas!
[url=https://discord.gg/7ktzgNga][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/6acdebeb7a275da3af8edc53458ebb77f26ae549.png[/img][/url]

Stay cool, Voyagers!
[b][i]Snowcastle Games[/i][/b]

notes.title: Can You Survive The Heat?
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Explorers![/h1]

In today’s update, we’re diving into your greatest enemy in Lysward: the relentless heat.

As you’ve seen in our latest updates, Lysward is a single-player survival adventure game set in a brutal, arid desert. And that means one thing: this place is HOT. We’re talking walking-on-the-Sun levels of hot. 🥵

So, with heat this intense, how do you survive it? We have some plans to share.

Please mind that this is still a work in progress, and some things might change between now and the launch.

[h3]Heat Attacks, Buildings Protect[/h3]At the start of your journey, you’ll come across a building—an outpost, as we call it. Inside, you’ll find things that will help you stay safe from the scorching sun, including shelter, a crafting station, and plenty of other useful resources.

Run to the outpost to avoid overheating! 
[previewyoutube=XLMUNWsIDp8;full][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3]The Perfect Place for Shade[/h3]
Another way of avoiding overheating is hiding in the shade. While exploring the sands and gathering resources, you’ll notice your temperature skyrockets if you’re exposed to direct sunlight for too long. To avoid overheating, use the shadows around you. Planning a route that’s rich in shade will make your adventure a little more manageable.

But sometimes, sticking to the shadows isn’t enough. The environment around you remains incredibly hot, and you might ask us: what about dehydration?
[previewyoutube=UUi2KcASPkM;full][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h3]Stay Hydrated![/h3]
One of the first crafting recipes you’ll learn is for a water bottle—your new best friend. While finding bodies of water in Lysward is no easy feat, you can refill your water bottle at the outpost. Make sure to do this every time you return to it, or you’ll find yourself parched with no water in sight while exploring the desert.
[previewyoutube=7MQYS3f0yS8;full][/previewyoutube]
Speaking of which… have you had enough water today? Go grab a bottle, then come back and wishlist our game! Having players wishlisting a game is incredibly important for indie developers, as it shows the level of interest and excitement players have for our game. So hit that green button right now if you like what you see here!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2994600/Lysward][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/6acdebeb7a275da3af8edc53458ebb77f26ae549.png[/img][/url]
And remember, Lysward is still in development, so some of the features we’ve shown here might evolve and change as we keep building the game. Your feedback is also incredibly valuable to us.

If you want to be a part of our community, ask the devs any questions, or maybe just talk to other fellow explorers, our Discord is the hottest place to go (no pun intended). Join the adventure!
[url=https://discord.gg/uC7UudkP][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/b522c6876a94580fb21d840c283d34050ac930b9.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Welcome To Lysward!
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to Lysward!

To those of you who are new here, we're Snowcastle Games, an independent game developer based in Norway. You might know us from the nostalgic JRPG EARTHLOCK or the cozy Ikonei Island. We're now working on Lysward, a single-player survival adventure set in the desert.

Yes, desert! We’re pretty sure you’ve seen Norwegian people making games about desert before (if you know, you know).

We’re explorers by nature so we decided to step outside our “snowy” comfort zone and create a game set in a harsh desert where survival hinges on your ability to adapt, find resources, and create deep relationships with your crew.

So climb on board and let’s explore it together.

[previewyoutube=Te5ult-0RrY;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Lysward Official Teaser[/i][hr][/hr]
[h3]The desert is unforgiving[/h3]
The name “Lysward” is a fusion of two elements: “Lys,” the name of the Sun in the EARTHLOCK universe, and also a Norwegian word for “light”; and “ward,” symbolizing a journey or movement. We chose this title to evoke a sense of exploration and adventure.

Lysward is set in a vast and unforgiving desert within the fantastical world of Umbra. If you've played our other games, you might recognize a few familiar elements.
The planet Umbra doesn't turn, so the sun is stationary in the sky. This bathes one part of the world in perpetual daylight and makes the intense heat your enemy number one. The sun is also the source of a powerful magic called Amri.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/92da1842445ddb14ae43a2578c4c23da951e9628.gif[/img]

You'll play as an escaped experiment from the facility that was both his home and prison. You will have to navigate this treacherous desert, where the sun's relentless heat can quickly overwhelm you. A key way to ensure your survival is to search for remains of advanced technology left behind by ancient civilizations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/901a4d684793b04c495b9d57471d9a7c37dd3673.png[/img]

To endure the relentless heat, you’ll need to explore the sands, scavenge for resources, and craft tools and technologies to help you on your journey. Master the art of survival, and the desert will reveal wonders beyond your imagination.

[h3]Exploring the sands[/h3]
As we announced [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/826640/view/576003055336555243]here[/url], we're leveraging many of the tools we developed for EARTHLOCK 2 in the creation of Lysward.  One of the most important gameplay elements is the Speeder, a small but fast vehicle that’s not just your ride across the sands, but also a mobile base of operations for you and your companion. While it offers heat protection, the Speeder can be damaged and will require repairs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/d504e74101afee7997f88b6ab20074d27492244f.gif[/img]

[h3]Join the adventure[/h3]
If you liked what you saw here, please consider adding Lysward to your wishlist. It shows us how much interest there is in the game and helps with visibility.

We will be having a closed playtest soon, so don’t forget to join our Discord community if you want to be part of it!

[url=https://discord.gg/uC7UudkP][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538408/a81f1901d5cff880ec6ed580afc4d615998a37c7.png[/img][/url]
See you soon!
[i][b]Snowcastle Games[/b][/i]
